name: Quote card
oneLiner: a magazine page torn along one edge is set down on a black leather blotter: a giant serif quote mark strikes in the brand colour, the quote prints line by line in an editorial italic, a cut-out portrait is taped beside the name and a marker underlines the words that matter
say: when the speaker quotes someone ('one customer told me...', 'as she put it'): the page lands on the quote, the underline hits the words they lean on
